module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM loads operands on start, adds the shifted multiplicand per multiplier bit for 16 cycles, then pulses done.

anchors.name: n9_044
anchors.why: Idle/run/finish state register sequencing operand load, 16 add-shift iterations and done pulse.

anchors.name: n0_9d7
anchors.why: Start input: in idle, loads operands, clears accumulator and counter, enters run state.

anchors.name: n8_46d
anchors.why: 32-bit product output, direct copy of the accumulator register.

anchors.name: n4_fa5
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse in finish state marking product valid.

anchors.name: n3_c69
anchors.why: 16-bit multiplicand operand loaded zero-extended into the left-shift register.

anchors.name: n14_d87
anchors.why: 16-bit multiplier operand loaded into the right-shift register.

anchors.name: n6_243
anchors.why: Multiplicand register, shifted left each iteration, added into accumulator.

anchors.name: n2_d93
anchors.why: Multiplier register shifted right; its LSB selects whether to add the multiplicand.

anchors.name: n10_368
anchors.why: Next partial product: accumulator plus multiplicand when multiplier LSB set.

anchors.name: n13_021
anchors.why: Iteration counter incremented per add-shift step; reaching 16 ends run state.

anchors.name: n7_37e
anchors.why: Busy level output decoded from FSM run state.

anchors.name: n5_9ab
anchors.why: Counter-equals-16 flag triggering transition to finish state.

groups.name: Control FSM
groups.description: Sequences load, iterate and done pulse; decodes busy.

groups.name: Shift-add datapath
groups.description: Multiplicand/multiplier shift registers, conditional adder and product accumulator.
